app.name: Used Book Market
app.tagline: The book gathering dust on your shelf is the one someone else is looking for
search.placeholder: Search by title, author or ISBN
home.hero.lead: The platform handles the whole sale: we review the book, take it in, ship it, and settle what the seller is owed.
home.featured.title: Featured books
home.featured.subtitle: Most viewed this week

home.newArrivals.subtitle: The latest copies to reach the warehouse

home.howItWorks.title: How it works
home.howItWorks.step1.title: List your book
home.howItWorks.step1.text: Photograph it, describe its condition, set a price, and send it for review.
home.howItWorks.step2.title: We review and receive
home.howItWorks.step2.text: We check the condition, the photographs and the details, then take the copy into the warehouse.
home.howItWorks.step3.title: We sell and ship
home.howItWorks.step3.text: We list the book, take the payment and ship it to the buyer.
home.howItWorks.step4.title: You get paid
home.howItWorks.step4.text: Once the order completes, your earnings become available to withdraw.
home.cta.title: Books you are not reading?
home.cta.text: Turn them into income and let the platform do the rest.
